skill: FABREMENT OPTIONS PAGES Use list-options-pages before creating one; get-options-page before changing its definition. Use the current save-options-page schema, slug and expectedRevision for updates. Creating a new slug requires expectedRevision:0 and page.title. Preserve omitted sections and treat fields as a complete active definition list, with the retirement rules in fields-contract. An options page holds shared structured values such as contact details; it is not an arbitrary WordPress option editor or an ACF options-page editor. Use get-field-values/set-field-values with the options selector from their schema for actual values. Do not confuse the definition revision with a value, or store data in the schema instead of filling it. Read existing values, patch only requested fields and respect nested validation. Values become visible only where theme code reads them: fabrement()->options('<slug>')->get_<type>('<name>'). These tools do not write that code. Check dependencies before delete-options-page and follow its explicit deletion/confirmation inputs.
